title: [FEATURE REQUEST] Add timezone to /status output
body:
When I enter `/status` in Claude Code, it outputs a time for when usage limits are reset. However, it does not specify a timezone so it is difficult to plan work around when the reset will occur. For example:

```
Claude Code Status v1.0.24

 Working Directory
  L /home/devuser/workspace

 Account • /login
  L Login Method: Claude Max Account
  L Organization: foobar@example.com's Organization
  L Email: foobar@example.com

 Memory • /memory
  L user: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md

 Model • /model
  L Default Opus 4 for up to 20% of usage limits, then use Sonnet 4 (currently Sonnet · Resets at 5pm)
```

It would be helpful to specify a timezone in the output.
author: ehausig
